text:
zoe: FYI ran into a parity gap with the Go SDK vs REST for cached responses + custom response headers. REST accepts `cache_ttl` and `response_headers` but Go SDK strips both.

mark: which sample app?

zoe: sample-apps/cache-proxy/go-proxy. snippet: 

```go
// go-sdk v0.6.0
_, err := client.Cache.Set(ctx, cache.SetParams{
    Key: "user:123",
    Value: "payload",
    CacheTTL: 300,
    ResponseHeaders: map[string]string{"x-source":"proxy"},
})
// -> server shows no cache_ttl or response headers
```

ivan: do you have the proxied request?

zoe: proxied body from SDK: `{"key":"user:123","value":"payload"}`. curl with same body plus `cache_ttl` works.

mark: looks like field names got dropped by the Go struct tags. Maybe json:"cache_ttl,omitempty" vs json:"cacheTtl" mismatch. Go codegen sometimes flattens or omits fields if tag wrong.

ivo: also note retry semantics differ: REST client treats cache Set as idempotent and retries on 502 once; Go SDK currently retries twice which caused duplicate writes and a race with eviction. Customer saw double-billing for storage ops.

zoe: exact error: server accepted request but monitoring shows two distinct store events. SDK logs show two attempts within 200ms.

mark: action items:
- regen Go SDK models and check struct tags for cache_ttl/response_headers
- add parity e2e test that asserts SDK payload JSON equals raw curl JSON for Cache.Set
- align retry policy: one retry for idempotent cache set, add idempotency token header so server can dedupe

qa-bot: Created issue redwood/go-sdk#89: "go SDK: Cache.Set omits cache_ttl and response_headers; retry duplication" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/89 :robot_face:

ivan: quick workaround is to call REST for now from the Go sample app or set `CacheTTL` via raw JSON body. I'll push a short PR to sample-apps to use HTTP for cache set.

zoe: thanks. tagging this P2 for now but if more customers hit duplication we escalate.

mark: I'll own the regen + test. Ivan please add idempotency token support to server side endpoint too.

zoe: will update the sample-app README and link issue.
